definitions.gloss: reading comprehension; interpretation of written text
definitions.explanation: The ability to read and understand written material, or the act of doing so. Commonly used in educational and language-learning contexts.

examples.japanese: {読解|どっかい}{力|りょく}を{鍛|きた}える。
examples.english: To strengthen one's reading comprehension skills.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}の{読解|どっかい}{問題|もんだい}が{難|むずか}しかった。
examples.english: The reading comprehension questions on the exam were difficult.

examples.japanese: {新聞|しんぶん}の{社説|しゃせつ}を{使|つか}って{読解|どっかい}の{練習|れんしゅう}をしている。
examples.english: I'm practicing reading comprehension using newspaper editorials.

notes:
USAGE:
{読解|どっかい} is used primarily in educational contexts — school curricula, language proficiency tests (JLPT, university entrance exams), and academic skill development.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {読解|どっかい}{力|りょく} (reading comprehension ability)
- {読解|どっかい}{問題|もんだい} (reading comprehension questions)
- {読解|どっかい}{練習|れんしゅう} (reading comprehension practice)
- {長文|ちょうぶん}{読解|どっかい} (long-passage reading comprehension)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{読|よ}み{取|と}る means "to read and interpret" as a verb. {読解|どっかい} is the noun form used for the skill or activity as a whole.
